column1: # Devanagari -> Gujarati exceptions. Every other character maps to the Gujarati character with the
# same Unicode name (Devanagari code point + 0x180). An empty 'gujarati' value keeps the Devanagari
# character. Edit this file (or a copy given as the mapping_file setting) to change a rule.
